description: Single sequential synthetic POSIX collector run on Intel macOS 15.8.1, Release -O3 -DNDEBUG. Shared mixed corpus: 25% integers, 75% booleans with one override. A historical root forces cold owned-buffer validation while the actual selected mapping remains live; the next epoch uses verified metadata certificates. Not a fleet throughput or production latency measurement. Qualification builds ran concurrently; timings include host scheduling noise.
accounting: Managed heap samples include collector marks, complete owned packs, graph scratch and certificates. Live mapping bytes are page-rounded virtual mapping admission, not physical file lengths or RSS. Global heap peak is cumulative across setup and both epochs; sampled peaks are per epoch. No additional mappings are admitted by collection.
